title: Topping Dobel
subject: a martabak manis seller in a Bekasi night street stall who argues with every customer that chocolate-cheese-peanut-condensed-milk is too much, then makes it anyway
caption: Garut hip metal funky in the style of Voice of Baceprot, a power trio fusing metal riffs with hip-hop groove. A slap-and-pop funk bass carrying the verses; a downtuned metal guitar answering with palm-muted riffs and wah-wah fills; hip-hop groove drums with a fat, heavy snare and half-time breakdowns. Punchy live trio sound, bass up front, tight and dry. Female mid-range voice, rapid rap-sung verses, a melodic shouted chorus with girl-gang backing shouts. 98 BPM, E minor. Cheeky, stubborn and bouncing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no nu-metal screaming, no EDM elements, no pop ballad bridge.
lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass, distorted guitar, drum groove]

[Verse 1]
Jam sembilan gerobak udah ngebul
Adonan tebel, mentega sebalok
Mas yang pakai helm minta semua
Cokelat keju kacang susu, sekalian wijen

[Pre-Chorus]
Gue bilang, Mas, itu kebanyakan
Dia bilang, Kak, gue yang makan

[Chorus]
Topping dobel, topping dobel
Martabak lu jadi kayak bantal
Gue protes, lu nggak denger
Ya udah, gue bikin juga

[Verse 2]
Mbak yang kedua minta pandan
Isinya ketan hitam sama Toblerone
Gue diem sebentar, tarik napas
Ini martabak apa eksperimen

[Pre-Chorus]
Gue bilang, Mbak, itu aneh banget
Dia bilang, Kak, coba dulu

[Chorus]
Topping dobel, topping dobel
Gue cicip, kok enak banget
Besok gue tulis di menu
Spesial Mbak yang aneh itu

[Outro - bass and drum break]
Satu lagi, Kak, yang biasa
